conventions: All pixel coordinates x (column), y (row) are 0-based: FITS pixel = value + 1; pixel centres at integers.
File byte offset of pixel (x, y) of an uncompressed 2040x2040 float32 plane = data_offset + 4*(y*2040 + x); big-endian IEEE-754.
sky2pix x/y = astropy WCS.all_world2pix(ra, dec, 0) (iterative inverse of the SIP A/B polynomials).
x_apbp_only = TAN inverse followed by the header AP/BP polynomials (no iteration); x_no_sip = TAN + CD only.
wavelength/bandwidth = astropy WCS(header, fobj=hdul, key='W') with .sip=None, wcs_pix2world(x, y, 0) (FITS -TAB bilinear lookup).
cutout window for a size of N pixels: x0 = ceil(x_target - N/2), x1 = x0 + N - 1 (same for y), clipped to 0..2039 (== astropy Cutout2D mode='trim' == IBE cutout service).
sha256_big_endian_bytes = SHA-256 of the window values, row-major (y outer, x inner), each value as 4 big-endian bytes exactly as stored in the FITS file (FLAGS: decoded int32).
solid_angle_arcsec2: calibration_map_value = dr1/solid_angle_pixel_map product (float32) at that pixel; wcs_jacobian_value = area from the per-exposure TAN+SIP Jacobian (agrees to <= 0.1 %).
JSON null stands for NaN / not applicable.
meta.verified: Pixel windows for the D2, D3 and D6 golden files were compared bit-for-bit with IBE cutout-service output (?center=133.7951,-7.2451&size=60px) on 2026-11-14; FLAGS decoded with an independent RICE_1 decoder and cross-checked against astropy for the whole D3 frame.
